candidate: Luo et al. 2022 Tvärminne Daphnia rock-pool metacommunity

response_member.name: code_SpatialCoex/Bayesian model fitting/data_M.csv
response_member.role: released annual Daphnia magna occupancy matrix Y_M

response_target.name: released_annual_daphnia_magna_recolonisation
response_target.risk_set: pool i with released annual Y_M(i,t)=0 at source year t
response_target.boundary: The paper defines annual occupancy as 1 if observed in at least one of two annual samples and 0 otherwise, and states that a small fraction of missing observations after 2008 were treated as zero. Therefore zero is interpreted only as the published/released annual endpoint code and is never called latent biological absence.
schema_gate_before_fit: selectively extract only the frozen data_M.csv member after once-only authorization
member name, CRC32 and uncompressed size must match the frozen ZIP directory
after deterministic CSV-header removal the matrix must be exactly 546 x 36
columns are prospectively mapped in order to years 1982..2017, matching the paper and the published R code read.csv(...,header=T) -> Y_M contract
values must be only 0, 1 or explicit missing tokens; explicit missing tokens, if any, are converted to 0 to reproduce the paper's released endpoint semantics
every transition must contain at least one current source before any model fit

temporal_design.split_rule: first 24 of 35 annual transitions for calibration; final 11 for heldout
temporal_design.rule_state_update_during_heldout: allowed only after each heldout transition outcome is observed

patch_size.use: log patch size as a shared conventional predictor; never a response

distance.use: frozen structural worlds and conventional connectivity predictors

temperature.use: source-year summer temperature in the shared conventional baseline

layer_a.node_universe: 546 response-independent rock-pool rows from frozen distance.csv
layer_a.current_sources: all released Y_M=1 pools at source year t
layer_a.source_weights: equal normalized weight across current sources
layer_a.kernel_scale_interpretation: response-blind analyst-choice scale equal to the frozen LCC50 threshold in released distance units; not a biological dispersal estimate

rules.raw_edge_support: exp(-d/0.274502525748238) for every distinct pool pair
rules.interpretation: full-support response-blind analytical world preserving nonzero long-distance possibility; not the fitted D. magna xi parameter

layer_a.transition_normalization: Q[s,j]=W[s,j]/(1+sum_k W[s,k]); candidate support is the equal-source mean of Q[s,j]
layer_a.rule_filter: after each observed transition, eliminate a surviving rule if any newly positive 0->1 target has support <=1e-15
layer_a.monotonicity: surviving rule IDs may only remain or contract; eliminated rules never return
layer_a.falsification: if all five rules are eliminated, stop and report frozen-universe falsification without retuning

shared_geometry_process_baseline.connectivity_formula: sum over current sources of A_source * exp(-d/0.274502525748238), truncated where specified
shared_geometry_process_baseline.boundary: This is a strong conventional single-species geometry/process baseline using the same response-independent patch size, temperature and connectivity information; it does not use EOG world identity. The full published multispecies Bayesian model is not used as an executable comparator because doing so would require opening the two nonfocal species response matrices before the D. magna test.

representation_estimability.scope: calibration rows after exact response-count gate but before model fitting
representation_estimability.rule: after dropping zero-SD columns, regress each Layer-B feature not already in mean-only by OLS on intercept + shared baseline + mean-only EOG features; require at least one residual SD >1e-8
representation_estimability.no_rescue: do not add features/worlds or redefine mean-only after this check

metrics.primary: macro-heldout-transition binary log loss across the 11 frozen heldout transitions
metrics.outer_units: annual transitions; pool rows do not create independent years

layer_b_vs_mean_only_favorable_if_all: Layer B has lower log loss in at least 6 of 11 heldout transitions
decision_rules.layer_b_vs_mean_only_adverse_if: macro logloss(layer_b - mean_only) > 0 and Layer B loses in at least 6 of 11 heldout transitions
external_added_value_favorable_if_all: macro Layer-B log loss is lower than geometry_process_logistic and geometry_process_rf
Layer B beats the better external baseline in at least 6 of 11 heldout transitions
decision_rules.otherwise: preserve no_confirmed_added_value, adverse, non_estimable or universe_falsified without retuning

no_retuning_after_response: count minima or released zero-imputed endpoint semantics
five Layer-A rules, kernel scale or structural thresholds
source weighting, loss support or support tolerance
